sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the concept of a 'smart plug' in the context of Home Automation. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A smart plug is an electronic adapter inserted into a standard wall outlet, allowing users to control and schedule connected appliances remotely using a smartphone application.

questions.question_text: State the primary educational purpose of organizing a 'Kaushal Mela' in a school environment. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The primary purpose is to provide students a collaborative platform to exhibit their vocational projects, demonstrate newly acquired practical skills, and build entrepreneurial confidence through public interaction.

questions.question_text: Why is identifying the target audience a critical first step before creating a product advertisement? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Identifying the target audience ensures the advertisement's core message, visual tone, and delivery medium are specifically tailored to appeal to the people most likely to purchase the product.

questions.question_text: You are selected as the head coordinator for the upcoming Kaushal Mela at your school. Outline the three main steps you would take to ensure the exhibition stalls are set up systematically. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, I will map out a floor plan allocating specific stall spaces for different project categories. Next, I will distribute a clear duty chart to the setup team. Finally, I will ensure adequate electrical and structural safety checks before opening.
